sentences.en: Every marriage has periods of disconnection.
sentences.zh: 每段婚姻都有疏离的时期。

sentences.en: But what if you could have fewer of them?
sentences.zh: 但如果能减少这种情况呢？

sentences.en: That's what I wanted for my marriage and what I wrote about for today's Sunday read.
sentences.zh: 这就是我对我的婚姻的期望，也是我为今天的周日读物撰写的内容。

sentences.en: I love my wife Jess deeply.
sentences.zh: 我深爱我的妻子杰丝。

sentences.en: From the start of our marriage, though, we've just had a lot of conflict.
sentences.zh: 然而从我们结婚之初，我们就一直有很多冲突。

sentences.en: Jess has always sprinted toward intimacy and vulnerability at a thousand miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 杰丝总是以时速一千英里的速度奔向亲密与袒露脆弱。

sentences.en: I'm pretty much the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我几乎完全相反。

sentences.en: And along the way, we've done a lot of couples therapy to try to smooth things out.
sentences.zh: 一路走来，我们做过很多次夫妻治疗，试图把事情理顺。

sentences.en: My name's Daniel Oppenheimer, and I'm a contributor to the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫丹尼尔·奥本海默，是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: I'm 48 years old, and I write about art, culture, and politics.
sentences.zh: 我48岁，写作内容涵盖艺术、文化和政治。

sentences.en: Also, my marriage.
sentences.zh: 还有我的婚姻。

sentences.en: Jess is also 48.
sentences.zh: 杰丝也是48岁。

sentences.en: We've been married 18 years and have three kids.
sentences.zh: 我们结婚18年了，育有三个孩子。

sentences.en: The oldest is about to go off to college.
sentences.zh: 老大快要上大学了。

sentences.en: A few years ago, in our eternal search for a theory or person to help improve our marriage, we heard about Terry Reel, who's pretty famous in the therapy world.
sentences.zh: 几年前，在我们永无止境地寻找能帮助改善婚姻的理论或人时，我们听说了特里·里尔，他在治疗界相当有名。

sentences.en: I always like to point out to people that he's Bruce Springsteen's couples therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 我总是喜欢向别人指出，他是布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀的夫妻治疗师。

sentences.en: Terry's great, but he is really expensive to see.
sentences.zh: 特里很棒，但他看诊的费用真的很贵。

sentences.en: He charges like $30,000 for a weekend intensive.
sentences.zh: 他周末的密集治疗收费大约三万美元。

sentences.en: He does sometimes offer low-cost therapy, but there's a catch.
sentences.zh: 他有时确实提供低成本治疗，但有个条件。

sentences.en: You have to be okay with having your sessions observed by other therapists and recorded for training purposes.
sentences.zh: 你必须接受你的治疗过程被其他治疗师观摩，并为培训目的而被录音。

sentences.en: We both had a lot of issues that we were bringing to therapy with Terry,
sentences.zh: 我们俩带着很多问题去找特里治疗，

sentences.en: but it became clear pretty quickly that my anger and how I deal with distress in general was a special kind of problem.
sentences.zh: 但很快就很清楚，我的愤怒以及我总体上处理痛苦的方式是一个特殊的问题。

sentences.en: I can blow up, and I've been dealing with that for years.
sentences.zh: 我会情绪爆发，我多年来一直在处理这个问题。

sentences.en: Pretty early on, Terry told me,
sentences.zh: 很早的时候，特里就对我说：

sentences.en: She's not going to leave you tomorrow, Dan, but if you don't get a handle on this, she is going to leave you.
sentences.zh: 她明天不会离开你，丹，但如果你不控制好这一点，她就会离开你。

sentences.en: And so we started eight sessions with Terry to try and make progress on that.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始了与特里的八次治疗，试图在这方面取得进展。

sentences.en: And surprisingly, we did.
sentences.zh: 出人意料的是，我们做到了。

sentences.en: So here's my article, and it's from the magazine's Love and Sex issue.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的文章，它来自杂志的爱与性专刊。

sentences.en: It's read by Robert Fass, and our producer today is Tally Abacassus.
sentences.zh: 由罗伯特·法斯朗读，我们今天的制作人是塔莉·阿巴卡苏斯。

sentences.en: The music you'll hear was written and performed by Aaron Esposito.
sentences.zh: 你将听到的音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托创作和演奏。

sentences.en: Also, there's some adult language in this article, just so you know.
sentences.zh: 另外，这篇文章里有一些成人用语，特此告知。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: One thing I've learned from being married to my wife, Jess, who is a couples therapist,
sentences.zh: 从与我的妻子杰丝——一位夫妻治疗师——的婚姻中，我学到的一件事是，

sentences.en: is how vast the distance is between the masks people show to the world and the messy realities that live behind them.
sentences.zh: 人们向世界展示的面具与背后杂乱的现实之间的差距有多么巨大。

sentences.en: Every couple knows its own drama, but we still fall prey to the illusion that all other couples have seamlessly satisfying relationships.
sentences.zh: 每对伴侣都知道各自的戏剧性，但我们仍然陷入一种错觉，以为所有其他伴侣都有着天衣无缝、令人满意的关系。

sentences.en: The truth about marriage, including my own, is that even the most functional couples are merely doing the best they can with the lives that have been bestowed on them.
sentences.zh: 关于婚姻的真相，包括我自己的婚姻在内，即便是最健康的伴侣，也只是在用命运赋予他们的生活尽力而为。

sentences.en: This past spring, Jess and I had the first of eight sessions of couples therapy with Terry Reel,
sentences.zh: 今年春天，杰丝和我与特里·里尔进行了八次夫妻治疗中的第一次，

sentences.en: a best-selling author and by far the most famous of the therapists we've seen during our marriage.
sentences.zh: 他是一位畅销书作家，也是我们婚姻期间见过的治疗师中最著名的一位。

sentences.en: In November, I watched the recording of that session for the first time since treatment.
sentences.zh: 十一月，自治疗结束后我第一次观看了那次治疗的录像。

sentences.en: In the footage, I see Jess and me as Reel might see us.
sentences.zh: 在录像中，我看到了里尔眼中我和杰丝的样子。

sentences.en: I look worn down, a little pained.
sentences.zh: 我看起来精疲力竭，带着一丝痛苦。

sentences.en: Jess looks to me like the same beachy blonde who dive-bombed into my life twenty years ago,
sentences.zh: 在我看来，杰丝依然是二十年前闯入我生活的那个充满海滩风情的金发女郎，

sentences.en: crashing at a few thousand miles per hour into the defenses against intimacy and vulnerability that I had dedicated so much energy to erecting.
sentences.zh: 以每小时几千英里的速度撞击着我耗费巨大精力建立起来的亲密与脆弱防御机制。

sentences.en: She is lithe and elfin, where I am dense and rough-planed.
sentences.zh: 她身形苗条、精灵般灵动，而我则敦实粗犷。

sentences.en: She looks tired, too, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，她看起来也很累。

sentences.en: Reel glows in the aura of his webcam light.
sentences.zh: 里尔在网络摄像头的微光中熠熠生辉。

sentences.en: At seventy-four, still elfin in his own right.
sentences.zh: 七十四岁了，他自己依然带着精灵般的特质。

sentences.en: He's pushing me harder than I'm used to being pushed by a therapist,
sentences.zh: 他给我的压力比我习惯的治疗师给我的要大，

sentences.en: expressing skepticism of what strikes him as an overly sanitized version of my internal monologue when I feel criticized by Jess.
sentences.zh: 对于我每当被杰丝批评时，那套在他看来过于美化的内心独白版本，他表达了怀疑。

sentences.en: If your hurt feelings could speak, what would they be saying?
sentences.zh: 如果受伤的感情会说话，它们会说些什么？

sentences.en: He asks.
sentences.zh: 他问。

sentences.en: I tell myself I try really hard.
sentences.zh: 我告诉自己，我真的很努力。

sentences.en: I try to be a good person.
sentences.zh: 我努力做一个好人。

sentences.en: I try to be thoughtful about Jess and what she needs.
sentences.zh: 我努力体贴杰丝以及她的需求。

sentences.en: Maybe I don't get to everything, but it's not because I'm not a good person.
sentences.zh: 也许我没有面面俱到，但这并不是因为我不是个好人。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Reel asks.
sentences.zh: 里尔问。

sentences.en: That's what it sounds like?
sentences.zh: 听起来是这样吗？

sentences.en: I laugh self-consciously.
sentences.zh: 我有些不自然地笑了一下。

sentences.en: Can I tell you what I think it sounds like?
sentences.zh: 我能告诉你我觉得它听起来像什么吗？

sentences.en: He asks.
sentences.zh: 他问。

sentences.en: Reel pauses, intensifies his tone, and confronts me with the kind of coarse language he is known to use with his male clients,
sentences.zh: 里尔停顿了一下，加重了语气，用那种他向来对男客户使用的粗俗语言质问我，

sentences.en: the language he believes they understand and respond to.
sentences.zh: 那种他认为他们能听懂并作出反应的语言。

sentences.en: No matter what I do, he says, no matter what I fucking do, no matter how hard I try, you're going to find the one damn thing I didn't do.
sentences.zh: 不管我做什么，他说，不管我他妈的做什么，不管我多么努力，你总能找出那件我没做的倒霉事。

sentences.en: I can't believe I have to put up with this bullshit again.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信自己又得忍受这种废话。

sentences.en: I concede the point.
sentences.zh: 我承认了这一点。

sentences.en: Jess, I can see on the video, is enjoying the scene.
sentences.zh: 从视频中可以看出，杰丝很享受这一幕。

sentences.en: Reel wants me to put more flesh on it.
sentences.zh: 里尔希望我给它加点血肉。

sentences.en: What does it actually sound and look like?
sentences.zh: 它听起来和看起来到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: What's a typical fight?
sentences.zh: 一场典型的争吵是怎样的？

sentences.en: It often begins, I say, when I think Jess is judging me, a form that one of the kids' needs signed for school has gone missing, and she draws attention to it.
sentences.zh: 通常是这样开始的，我说，当我以为杰丝在评判我时，比如学校需要签字的孩子需求单少了一张，而她指出了这一点。

sentences.en: It's an ostensibly neutral observation, but I'm pretty sure it's aimed in my direction.
sentences.zh: 这表面上是一个中立的观察，但我很确定它是冲着我来的。

sentences.en: Then there's another observation, or sigh, and I respond with what I think of as a direct but reasonable response, though I admit to Reel that there's an edge to it.
sentences.zh: 接着又是另一个观察或叹气，我做出了我认为直接但合理的反应，尽管我向里尔承认其中带有一点锋芒。

sentences.en: Hey, Jess, I've been up since 6.30 a.m.
sentences.zh: 嘿，杰丝，我从早上6点半就醒了。

sentences.en: I'm doing the best I can.
sentences.zh: 我在尽我所能。

sentences.en: Can you lay off?
sentences.zh: 你能放过我吗？

sentences.en: Reel describes this back to me more accurately as a mixed message.
sentences.zh: 里尔更准确地将此描述为混合信息，并反馈给我。

sentences.en: Reasonable with an edge to it, he says.
sentences.zh: 合理中带着锋芒，他说。

sentences.en: That's an interesting description.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的描述。

sentences.en: How much reason and how much edge you got.
sentences.zh: 你有多少道理，又有多少锋芒。

sentences.en: What happens next depends on how Jess responds.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事情取决于杰丝如何回应。

sentences.en: If I perceive defensiveness, I escalate to DEFCON 4.
sentences.zh: 如果我察觉到防御心理，我就会升级到戒备状态第4级。

sentences.en: More edge, less reason.
sentences.zh: 更多锋芒，更少道理。

sentences.en: If she pushes back again, I lose it.
sentences.zh: 如果她再次回击，我就彻底失控了。

sentences.en: That she won't validate me is intolerable.
sentences.zh: 她不肯认可我，这是令人无法容忍的。

sentences.en: My body floods with stress hormones, and I move rapidly to self-righteousness, pure victimhood.
sentences.zh: 我的体内涌满了压力荷尔蒙，我迅速陷入了自以为是、纯粹的受害者心态。

sentences.en: It ends with me yelling, maybe slamming a door and storming away.
sentences.zh: 结局通常是我大吼大叫，可能还会摔门而出。

sentences.en: If it's a really rough day, the kids will bear witness.
sentences.zh: 如果是非常糟糕的一天，孩子们会在一旁见证。

sentences.en: You blow up, Reel says.
sentences.zh: 你情绪爆发了，里尔说。

sentences.en: I blow up, I say.
sentences.zh: 我情绪爆发了，我说。

sentences.en: Pretty zero to 60.
sentences.zh: 基本上瞬间从0飙升到60。

sentences.en: And what does 60 sound like?
sentences.zh: 那60听起来是怎样的？

sentences.en: And be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 而且要诚实。

sentences.en: I pause for a few seconds.
sentences.zh: 我沉默了几秒钟。

sentences.en: I mean, it can sound like fuck you or Reel interrupts, giving what he calls the New Jersey
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听起来可能是去你妈的或者里尔打断了我，

sentences.en: Jew version of my response.
sentences.zh: 用他所谓的我那番话的新泽西犹太人版来表达。

sentences.en: Here, Jess, I'll just put a bullet through my brain and then you can be happy, okay?
sentences.zh: 给你，杰丝，我直接给自己脑袋来一枪，然后你就能开心了，好吗？

sentences.en: That sounds about right.
sentences.zh: 听起来差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: Jess is amused.
sentences.zh: 杰丝觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: This is what we signed up for.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所选择的。

sentences.en: Reel, whose admirers include Gwyneth Paltrow and Bruce Springsteen, is one of a small number
sentences.zh: 里尔的崇拜者包括格温妮丝·帕特罗和布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀，他是少数几位

sentences.en: of thinkers who are actively shaping how the couple's therapy field is received by the public and practiced by other therapists.
sentences.zh: 正在积极塑造公众对夫妻治疗的接受度以及其他治疗师执业方式的思想家之一。

sentences.en: He is also the bluntest and most charismatic of the therapists I've seen.
sentences.zh: 他也是我见过的治疗师中最直言不讳、最具个人魅力的一位。

sentences.en: The New Jersey Jewish version of Robin Williams' irascible Boston character in Good Will Hunting.
sentences.zh: 罗宾·威廉姆斯在《心灵捕手》中那个暴躁的波士顿角色的新泽西犹太人版。

sentences.en: Profane, charismatic, open about his own life, forged in his own story of pain.
sentences.zh: 满口粗话、极具魅力、对自己的生活坦诚相见，在自己痛苦的故事中千锤百炼。

sentences.en: He doesn't have his own show, as Orna Goralnik does, or a popular podcast like his friend and occasional collaborator, Esther Perel.
sentences.zh: 他没有奥娜·戈拉尔尼克那样自己的节目，也没有像他的朋友兼偶尔合作者埃丝特·佩瑞尔那样受欢迎的播客。

sentences.en: But like them, he is a maestro of interpersonal drama.
sentences.zh: 但和他们一样，他是人际关系戏剧的大师。

sentences.en: Perhaps his great distinction, in a field known for its gentleness and neutrality, is the force with which he confronts clients, particularly men, about their immaturity.
sentences.zh: 在以温和和中立著称的领域中，他或许最显著的特点，就是他以极具冲击力的方式就男性的不成熟问题质问客户，尤其是男性。

sentences.en: That we were able to see him remains surprising, as does the fact that I can now watch it unfold before me.
sentences.zh: 我们能见到他至今仍令人惊讶，就像我能看着这一切在眼前展开一样。

sentences.en: Early last year, Jess got an email from a fellow therapist saying that Reel would provide affordable
sentences.zh: 去年年初，杰丝收到了一位同行治疗师的电子邮件，说如果一对伴侣同意在Zoom上进行治疗，

sentences.en: therapy to a couple if they agreed to do the sessions on Zoom before an audience of therapists recorded for his training library.
sentences.zh: 并在由治疗师组成的观众面前进行，同时为他的培训资料库进行录像，里尔就会为他们提供负担得起的治疗。

sentences.en: Despite some misgivings, we volunteered, waiving confidentiality.
sentences.zh: 尽管有些疑虑，我们还是自愿报名了，并放弃了保密协议。

sentences.en: It was an offer we didn't feel we had the luxury to refuse.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们觉得没有奢侈去拒绝的机会。

sentences.en: After so many years and so much earnest effort, we had a good marriage on balance, but not always a good enough one.
sentences.zh: 经过这么多年和如此真诚的努力，总的来说我们的婚姻还算不错，但并不总是足够好。

sentences.en: Our relationship was a melange of genres.
sentences.zh: 我们的关系就像是各种流派的大杂烩。

sentences.en: Sometimes we were like Alvy and Annie in Woody Allen's Annie Hall, witty and sophisticated, but unable to reach across the emotional chasm between us.
sentences.zh: 有时我们就像伍迪·艾伦的《安妮·霍尔》中的阿尔维和安妮，机智而成熟，却无法跨越我们之间情感的鸿沟。

sentences.en: At our best, we were a Judd Apatow comedy, bawdy, silly, earnest, and full of affection for each other.
sentences.zh: 在我们状态最好时，我们是一部贾德·阿帕图式的喜剧，低俗、滑稽、真诚，并且充满了对彼此的爱意。

sentences.en: At our worst, we were a cold indie film about two people mired in distance and reproach.
sentences.zh: 在我们状态最差时，我们是一部冷门独立电影，讲述两个人深陷于疏离与指责之中。

sentences.en: I didn't think too deeply about Reel when he first crept into our lives around 2020.
sentences.zh: 当里尔在2020年前后首次悄然进入我们的生活时，我并没有对他的事情深思。

sentences.en: Jess read his book, The New Rules of Marriage, then Us, Getting Past You and Me to Build a More
sentences.zh: 杰丝读了他的书《婚姻的新规则》，然后是《我们：跨越你我以建立更深爱关系》，

sentences.en: Loving Relationship, and pushed him on me with real urgency.
sentences.zh: 并带着真正的急迫感把这本书推给我。

sentences.en: His earthiness spoke to her, as did his belief that we have a right to expect far more from our partners than just solidity and empathy.
sentences.zh: 他的接地气吸引了她，正如他所坚信的那样——我们有权对伴侣抱有更多的期望，而不仅仅是稳固和共情。

sentences.en: We should want and demand deep connection and honesty.
sentences.zh: 我们应该渴望并要求深度的连接与诚实。

sentences.en: I also suspect that he validated her sense that, in the grand ledger of our marriage, I was the balance of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我也怀疑，他证实了她的那种感觉：在我们婚姻的宏大账本中，问题全出在我身上。

sentences.en: To Jess, I am, at my worst, too angry, too withdrawn, too talky about the small things, and too inarticulate about the big ones.
sentences.zh: 对杰丝来说，处于最糟糕状态的我，过于愤怒，过于退缩，对小事喋喋不休，而对大事却笨口拙舌。

sentences.en: Reel is known for his skill in handling men who cope using anger and withdrawal.
sentences.zh: 里尔以擅长应对那些通过愤怒和退缩来应对问题的男性而闻名。

sentences.en: In the footage from that first session, I look anxious.
sentences.zh: 在那次初次治疗的录像中，我看起来很焦虑。

sentences.en: I rumple my hair and smoosh my chin in my hand.
sentences.zh: 我揉乱头发，把下巴按在手心里。

sentences.en: I'm always looking up and off screen, as though what's happening in front of me is a bit too much to face head on.
sentences.zh: 我总是抬头看着屏幕外，仿佛眼前发生的事情有点让人难以直面。

sentences.en: I remember the discomfort in the moment, as Reel drew me out.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时里尔诱导我开口时的那种不适感。

sentences.en: I also know, looking back, what's in store for me.
sentences.zh: 回过头来看，我也知道等待我的是什么。

sentences.en: He is establishing the crime scene for which I will need to take responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他正在为我需要承担责任的犯罪现场奠定基础。

sentences.en: I'm cognizant now, too, of Jess's uncomfortable smile, which I couldn't see when we were sitting side by side.
sentences.zh: 现在我也意识到了杰丝那尴尬的微笑，当我们并肩坐着时我是看不到的。

sentences.en: She's more private than I am, less practiced in performing her distress for an audience, and she is acutely aware of the therapists watching us.
sentences.zh: 她比我更注重隐私，不太习惯在观众面前表演她的痛苦，而且她敏锐地意识到治疗师们正在看着我们。

sentences.en: We're there because Jess wanted Reel's help more than she feared the public vulnerability, but it's hard on her.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里是因为杰丝渴望得到里尔的帮助，胜过她对公开袒露脆弱的恐惧，但这对外向的她来说很艰难。

sentences.en: Toward the end of the session, Reel gives me a verdict.
sentences.zh: 在治疗快结束时，里尔给我下了一个定论。

sentences.en: That's a t-shirt you're wearing in your marriage, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是你在婚姻中穿着的一件体恤。

sentences.en: No matter what I fucking do, it's never going to be enough for you.
sentences.zh: 无论我他妈的怎么做，对你来说永远都不够。

sentences.en: I've been wearing it, he says, since before I met Jess, and unless I take a hard look at myself and get to work, I'll die with it on.
sentences.zh: 他说，自从认识杰丝之前我就一直在穿它，除非我深刻反省并开始行动，否则我死的时候也会穿着它。

sentences.en: I believe it, I say.
sentences.zh: 我相信，我说。

sentences.en: I believe it.
sentences.zh: 我真的相信。

sentences.en: Good, Reel says.
sentences.zh: 很好，里尔说。

sentences.en: Let's fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们来修复它。

sentences.en: You want to fix it?
sentences.zh: 你想修复它吗？

sentences.en: I would love to fix it.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意修复它。

sentences.en: Reel's first book, I Don't Want to Talk About It,
sentences.zh: 里尔的第一本书《我不想谈这个》，

sentences.en: Overcoming the Secret Legacy of Male Depression, is an extended disquisition on male pain and loneliness,
sentences.zh: 《克服男性抑郁的秘密遗产》，是对男性痛苦与孤独的深入探讨，

sentences.en: rooted in the belief that men are depressed because they're terrible at intimacy.
sentences.zh: 其根源在于这样一种信念：男性之所以抑郁，是因为他们极不擅长亲密关系。

sentences.en: They're terrible at intimacy because their capacities for it were extinguished in childhood.
sentences.zh: 他们不擅长亲密关系，是因为他们在童年时期建立亲密关系的能力被扼杀了。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to be this way, Reel argues.
sentences.zh: 里尔认为，事情本不必如此。

sentences.en: We condition boys to repress their feelings, desires, and ability to connect.
sentences.zh: 我们让男孩习惯于压抑自己的情感、欲望和连接能力。

sentences.en: It's no surprise, then, that so many of them grow up to be half-men, depressed, lonely, angry, and empty.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们当中有这么多人长大后变成半个人，抑郁、孤独、愤怒且空虚，也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: Too often, he writes, the wounded boy grows up to become a wounding man, inflicting upon those closest to him the very distress he refuses to acknowledge within himself.
sentences.zh: 他写道，很多时候，受过创伤的男孩长大后会变成一个伤害他人的人，将他拒绝承认的内痛苦加诸于他最亲近的人身上。

sentences.en: The real kicker is that often they don't even know this is happening.
sentences.zh: 最让人意想不到的是，他们往往甚至不知道这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: They're just acting out or shutting down blindly.
sentences.zh: 他们只是盲目地发泄或封闭自己。

sentences.en: Published in 1997, I Don't Want to Talk About It was the first book to give voice, not just to the choked pain of depressed men, but also of their suffering partners.
sentences.zh: 出版于1997年的《我不想谈这个》，是第一本不仅为抑郁男性的哽咽痛苦发声，也为他们痛苦的伴侣发声的书。

sentences.en: Almost three decades later, it still reads well.
sentences.zh: 将近三十年过去了，它读起来依然很好。

sentences.en: What strikes me now, maybe more than it would have struck a reader back in the 90s, is how wise the book is about the role that power plays in all this.
sentences.zh: 现在让我感触最深的，或许比90年代的读者更有感触的，是这本书对于权力在这一切中所扮演角色的深刻见解。

sentences.en: This is a through line in all of Reel's work, the necessity of exercising power in relationships, but also the profound difference between wielding it in loving relation to others
sentences.zh: 这是里尔所有作品贯穿始终的主线，即在关系中行使权力的必要性，但同时也存在着深刻的区别：是以充满爱的方式与他人建立联系来行使权力，

sentences.en: and using it to dominate them.
sentences.zh: 还是用它来支配他们。

sentences.en: He is not asking men to sacrifice their power to their partners.
sentences.zh: 他并不是要求男人们向伴侣牺牲自己的权力。

sentences.en: He asks that we stop exercising power the way little boys do, with tantrums, bullying, sulking, hitting, silence, whenever someone tries to talk to us about feelings.
sentences.zh: 他要求我们停止像小男孩那样行使权力——每当有人试图跟我们谈论感受时，就大发脾气、霸凌、生闷气、打人、保持沉默。

sentences.en: In the place of our well-crafted defenses, he insists, we should aspire to fierce intimacy, a healthy inversion of the wounded intensity of the traumatized person.
sentences.zh: 他坚称，我们应该用激烈的亲密感来取代我们精心构筑的防御，这是对受创者那受伤的强烈情感的一种健康反转。

sentences.en: We need to reach into the parts of ourselves that so many of us have cordoned off and express them, so that we can say what we feel, ask for what we desire,
sentences.zh: 我们需要触及我们许多人已经隔离的内心深处并将其表达出来，这样我们就能说出我们的感受，说出我们的渴望，

sentences.en: and assert control over how we behave in our relationship.
sentences.zh: 并在我们的关系中对自己的行为掌控自如。

sentences.en: All of that, though, requires that we be strong enough to listen openly to our partners when they express their own desires, fears, and frustrations,
sentences.zh: 然而，所有这一切都要求我们必须足够坚强，当我们的伴侣表达她们的渴望、恐惧和挫折感时，能够敞开心扉倾听，

sentences.en: and that we work through inevitable differences with loving candor.
sentences.zh: 并且以充满爱的坦诚来解决不可避免的分歧。

sentences.en: This intimacy is one in which men embrace qualities of emotionality, introspection, and affection that have historically been typed as feminine,
sentences.zh: 这种亲密感是男性拥抱历史上被归为女性的情感、内省和温情特质，

sentences.en: and women practice habits of strength and assertion that have long been typed as masculine.
sentences.zh: 而女性则践行长期以来被归为男性的力量与自信习惯。

sentences.en: There is great compassion for the pain people have endured, but little tolerance for playing the martyr.
sentences.zh: 人们对人们所承受的痛苦抱有极大的同情，但对扮演殉道者却鲜有容忍。

sentences.en: He calls this relational empowerment, a subtle but profound shift from the individualistic focus so central to our culture of therapy, self-help, and self-care.
sentences.zh: 他称之为关系赋权，这是从我们治疗、自助和自我关怀文化核心的个人主义焦点，向外迈出微妙而深远的一步。

sentences.en: The goal is to develop the strength to confront your own traumas so that you can be better for and demand more of your loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是培养直面自身创伤的力量，以便你能更好地对待你的挚爱，并对他们提出更高要求。

sentences.en: All over this culture, you have people moving from disempowerment to what I call individual empowerment.
sentences.zh: 在这种文化中到处都是这样的人，他们从失去力量转向我所谓的个人赋权。

sentences.en: He says, I was weak, now I'm strong, go fuck yourself.
sentences.zh: 他说，我曾经很弱，现在我很强，滚蛋吧。

sentences.en: Relational empowerment is, I was weak, now I'm strong,
sentences.zh: 关系赋权则是，我曾经很弱，现在我很强，

sentences.en: I'm bringing my strength into this relationship,
sentences.zh: 我把我的力量带入这段关系中，

sentences.en: I'm telling you what I need, I'm being assertive, I love you, what do you need from me to help you do this?
sentences.zh: 我告诉你我需要什么，我很自信，我爱你，你需要我做些什么来帮完成这件事？

sentences.en: In therapy with Rel, learning relational empowerment can be bracing.
sentences.zh: 在与里尔一起做心理治疗时，学习关系赋权可能会让人感到精神振奋。

sentences.en: He takes sides, calls for big change in short order, and describes with forensic precision what stands on the other side of failure, divorce, disconnection, loneliness.
sentences.zh: 他立场鲜明，要求在短时间内做出重大改变，并以如法医般的精准度描述了失败、离婚、疏离和孤独的另一面是什么。

sentences.en: It is no fun to be called out for behaving like a child, but there is relief, even excitement, to being held in Rel's gravitational field.
sentences.zh: 被人指出像小孩子一样行事绝非趣事，但在里尔的引力场中被接住，却会带来解脱，甚至是兴奋。

sentences.en: It puts you at the center of the drama, creating space for you to step into the role of hero.
sentences.zh: 它把你置于戏剧的中心，为你创造空间去扮演英雄的角色。

sentences.en: What it reminds me of, more than any therapy I've had, is my days on the wrestling team in high school, learning under the square-jawed care of our coaches, Bill and Hank,
sentences.zh: 比起我经历过的任何心理治疗，这更让我想起我在高中摔跤队的那些日子，在我们的教练比尔和汉克的方下巴关怀下学习，

sentences.en: a father and son duo who looked as if they had stepped directly out of central casting for Coach Old School.
sentences.zh: 一对父子组合，看起来就像是从老派教练的中央选角中直接走出来的。

sentences.en: There was a satisfaction to hustling for them, earning their hard-won approval.
sentences.zh: 为他们奔忙、赢得他们来之不易的认可，是一种满足。

sentences.en: Even their disappointment had its compensations.
sentences.zh: 甚至他们的失望也有其补偿之处。

sentences.en: Once in a while, on a day when we were slacking in practice,
sentences.zh: 偶尔，在我们训练懈怠的日子里，

sentences.en: Bill, or Buff as we called him, would launch into an expletive-laden tirade about what a bunch of coddled children we were,
sentences.zh: 比尔——我们叫他布夫——会开始一场充满脏话的慷慨激昂的演说，痛斥我们是一群被宠坏的孩子，

sentences.en: or how much we'd been given, and how little we seemed intent on making of it.
sentences.zh: 或者我们得到了多少，而我们似乎决心用它来成就的却微乎其微。

sentences.en: It was clear by the second or third year in a row that we earned this speech, that it was a performance.
sentences.zh: 到了连续第二年或第三年，很明显我们是自找这番训话，这只是一场表演。

sentences.en: It was exhilarating anyway.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这依然令人振奋。

sentences.en: There was respect in the accusation.
sentences.zh: 指责之中带有尊重。

sentences.en: Buff was judging us as men, even if the judgment was hard.
sentences.zh: 布夫是在以男人的标准来评判我们，即使这种评判是严厉的。

sentences.en: He was disappointed in our behavior, but only because he knew we were capable of more.
sentences.zh: 他对我们的行为感到失望，但这仅仅是因为他知道我们有能力做得更好。

sentences.en: Real has that maneuvered down, although there's far more obvious affection in the mix than I'm used to receiving from the patriarchs I've encountered in my life.
sentences.zh: 里尔很擅长这种策略，尽管其中包含着远比我生命中遇到的那些大家长们所习惯给予的要明显得多的深情。

sentences.en: This is the truth, man.
sentences.zh: 老兄，这就是事实。

sentences.en: This is what you're capable of, and what you should expect of yourself.
sentences.zh: 这就是你有能力做到的，也是你应该对自己的期望。

sentences.en: I can't make you do anything, but I can tell you what I see, and describe both the cost, if you keep this up, and the reward, if you can change.
sentences.zh: 我不能强迫你做任何事，但我可以告诉你我看到了什么，并描述出如果你继续这样下去的代价，以及如果你能改变所带来的回报。

sentences.en: And I'm here for you, every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 而且我会一路陪伴着你。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天都创作《拼字蜜蜂》和《字母密室》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 键入 games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: After our first session,
sentences.zh: 在我们的第一次咨询之后，

sentences.en: Jess was visibly relieved.
sentences.zh: 杰丝明显松了一口气。

sentences.en: Riel had skillfully challenged me, and I was more open to the challenge than she expected me to be.
sentences.zh: 里尔巧妙地向我发起了挑战，而我对这一挑战的接受度比她预期的要高。

sentences.en: In the days after the session, the symbolic t-shirt became a running joke between us.
sentences.zh: 咨询结束后的几天里，这件象征意义的体恤衫成了我们之间的常用笑话。

sentences.en: In the next session,
sentences.zh: 在下一次咨询中，

sentences.en: Riel turned to Jess, asking her to reflect on the first session, on me, on herself.
sentences.zh: 里尔转向杰丝，请她反思第一次咨询、反思我、反思她自己。

sentences.en: Watching her on camera,
sentences.zh: 在镜头里看着她，

sentences.en: I'm struck by how much more vulnerable she allows herself to be.
sentences.zh: 我惊叹于她允许自己表现出如此多的脆弱。

sentences.en: How close at hand her full range of emotions are, even when she's expressing skepticism.
sentences.zh: 即使在她表达怀疑的时候，她的各种情绪也是多么触手可及。

sentences.en: I'm always sure I'm on the precipice of change.
sentences.zh: 我总是确信自己正处于改变的边缘。

sentences.en: She has learned to know better.
sentences.zh: 她已经吸取了教训。

sentences.en: The previous session gave her hope, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，上一次的咨询给了她希望。

sentences.en: Maybe there can be more closeness in our relationship.
sentences.zh: 也许我们的关系可以更亲密一些。

sentences.en: It also made her sad.
sentences.zh: 这也让她感到难过。

sentences.en: There were so many years lost to conflict and fear.
sentences.zh: 有那么多岁月在冲突和恐惧中白白流逝。

sentences.en: I used to fight more for the closeness, she laments.
sentences.zh: 她感叹道，我过去为了亲密感做过更多抗争。

sentences.en: And over time,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: I've just withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 我只是退缩了。

sentences.en: I remember wanting to argue with her when she said that.
sentences.zh: 我记得当她说这话时，我很想跟她争辩。

sentences.en: In my story of our relationship, she has always wielded the threat of distance when she feels rejected or abandoned.
sentences.zh: 在我们这段关系的叙事中，每当她感到被拒绝或被抛弃时，她总是挥舞着疏离的威胁。

sentences.en: It's not a product of my actions, I wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 我想说，这不是我行为的结果。

sentences.en: I couldn't deny, though, that I have given her ample reason to be wary.
sentences.zh: 不过，我无法否认，我确实给了她足够的理由去保持警惕。

sentences.en: Early in our marriage, I would simmer for days, accumulating a resentful charge until a tiny remark, a gesture, a joke, sparked an explosion.
sentences.zh: 在我们婚姻的早期，我会生闷气好几天，积聚着怨恨的情绪，直到一句微不足道的话、一个手势、一个笑话引发了一场爆炸。

sentences.en: The content changes, but the form is the same.
sentences.zh: 内容变了，但形式依旧。

sentences.en: At a recent dinner with friends,
sentences.zh: 在最近的一次朋友聚餐上，

sentences.en: I mentioned an exchange I had in the comments section of Substack, where I publish a podcast and newsletter.
sentences.zh: 我提到了我在 Substack 的评论区里的一次交流，我在那里发布播客和时事通讯。

sentences.en: It's good you have so much time to spend on social media,
sentences.zh: 真好啊，你有这么多时间花在社交媒体上，

sentences.en: Jess said.
sentences.zh: 杰丝说。

sentences.en: It took me all of a nanosecond or so to conclude that she was annoyed with me.
sentences.zh: 我花了大概十亿分之一秒的时间就断定她生我的气了。

sentences.en: She'd been taking on more than her share of domestic duties over the previous few weeks, so that I could finish an important project at work.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，她承担了超出她应分担的家务，好让我能完成工作中的一个重要项目。

sentences.en: And I intuited, or perhaps imagined, that she didn't love me noodling around on Substack.
sentences.zh: 我直觉到，或者也许是想象到，她并不喜欢我在 Substack 上瞎折腾。

sentences.en: It was time I should have spent more constructively.
sentences.zh: 那是本该用来做更有建设性事情的时间。

sentences.en: Without even thinking about it, I swore at her in front of our friends.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都没多想，就在我们的朋友面前对她暴粗口。

sentences.en: By the time we were in therapy with Reel, the circuit was lower voltage, but the sensitivity remained.
sentences.zh: 等到我们去找里尔做心理治疗时，回路的电压虽然降低了，但敏感度依然存在。

sentences.en: If I was on alert, all it took was a tease from her with a smidgen of subtext or a tossed-off complaint to trigger a reaction.
sentences.zh: 如果我处于戒备状态，只需要她一句带有微小潜台词的调侃或一句随口抱怨，就能触发我的反应。

sentences.en: Then we would go at it, our familiar dance of distruSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就会大吵起来，这是我们熟悉的不信任之舞。

sentences.en: Her dart, my anger, her fear, my grievances, her grievances.
sentences.zh: 她的尖刻，我的愤怒，她的恐惧，我的委屈，她的委屈。

sentences.en: She doesn't care about me.
sentences.zh: 他不在乎我。

sentences.en: He doesn't care about me.
sentences.zh: 她不在乎我。

sentences.en: This is us trapped in what Reel calls our core negative image of each other.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们陷入里尔所说的彼此核心负面形象的困境。

sentences.en: It is not all of us.
sentences.zh: 这并不代表全部的我们。

sentences.en: We have a lot in common, including a fascination with human relationships and an endearing tendency to overanalyze them.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多共同点，包括对人际关系的着迷以及过度分析它们的可爱倾向。

sentences.en: We both love music by feely white dudes with beards.
sentences.zh: 我们都喜欢蓄着胡须的敏感白人男子的音乐。

sentences.en: We are united in our devotion to our three children.
sentences.zh: 我们对三个孩子的爱让我们紧密相连。

sentences.en: Too often, though, we revert to the worst stories we have about each other.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们常常退回到对彼此最糟糕的看法中。

sentences.en: In the videos of our sessions, I can see Reel carefully stepping around and through these narratives, helping us to revise them.
sentences.zh: 在我们咨询的视频中，我可以看到里尔小心翼翼地绕过并穿过这些叙事，帮助我们修正它们。

sentences.en: The raw material isn't new.
sentences.zh: 这些原材料并不新鲜。

sentences.en: We've been over our childhoods before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前就探讨过各自的童年。

sentences.en: We've talked about our fights.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论过我们的争吵。

sentences.en: We've diagnosed ourselves, cataloged our wounds and each other's flaws.
sentences.zh: 我们自我诊断过，将我们的创伤和彼此的缺点列成目录。

sentences.en: But in conversation with Reel, it feels different.
sentences.zh: 但与里尔交谈时，感觉却完全不同。

sentences.en: He explains, more cogently than we've gotten from a couple's therapist before, why we sought each other out, drive each other crazy, and have the potential to be great together.
sentences.zh: 他比我们以往任何一位夫妻治疗师都更有说服力地解释了，为什么我们互相吸引、把对方逼疯，以及我们在一起有多大的潜力成为伟大的一对。

sentences.en: In our hearts,
sentences.zh: 在我们的内心里，

sentences.en: Reel said in one of our sessions, we all think that we deserve the goddess or God who will deliver us from our childhood, even heal us and make it all better
sentences.zh: 里尔在一次咨询中说，我们都认为自己配得上那位能把我们从童年中拯救出来，甚至治愈我们、让一切变得更好，

sentences.en: and give to us what we didn't get.
sentences.zh: 并给予我们未曾得到的东西的女神或男神。

sentences.en: What we wind up with is somebody who is perfectly designed to stick it to us.
sentences.zh: 而我们最终得到的，却是一个完美设计来狠狠打击我们的人。

sentences.en: When we began dating at the end of our 20s, it was an easy decision to marry Jess, but also a terrifying one.
sentences.zh: 当我们二十多岁快结束时开始约会，娶杰丝是一个轻易就能做出的决定，但也同样令人恐惧。

sentences.en: She was so charismatic, sexy, whip-smart, shockingly sensitive to the subtleties of human interaction.
sentences.zh: 她那么有魅力、性感、聪明绝顶，对人际交往的微妙之处有着惊人的敏感。

sentences.en: I shared her intellectual interest in relationships, but not her compulsion toward them.
sentences.zh: 我分享了她对人际关系的学术兴趣，却没有她那种对关系的强烈执念。

sentences.en: She hadn't been single for more than a few months since she was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 从十几岁起，她单身的时间就没有超过几个月。

sentences.en: I had spent the previous decade engineering a life that defended against the threat of other people.
sentences.zh: 我过去十年都在精心构筑一种生活，来抵御来自他人的威胁。

sentences.en: No long-term relationships, six or so hours of television a day, and a job in journalism that gave me the regular simulacrum of intimacy without any of its real obligations.
sentences.zh: 没有长期的恋爱关系，每天看大约六小时电视，还有一份新闻业的工作，这给了我一种常规的亲密感幻象，却没有任何真实的义务。

sentences.en: She would lean in for more.
sentences.zh: 她会倾身寻求更多。

sentences.en: I would feel the threat of suffocation and lash out.
sentences.zh: 我会感到窒息的威胁并猛烈回击。

sentences.en: She would feel rejected and respond with great drama and threats of catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 她会觉得自己被拒绝，并以极具戏剧性的方式和灾难性的威胁来回应。

sentences.en: I would feel unseen and unloved.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得自己被忽视、不被爱。

sentences.en: Get away from me.
sentences.zh: 离我远点。

sentences.en: But also, how dare you fail to take care of me?
sentences.zh: 但同时又觉得，你怎么敢不照顾我？

sentences.en: Jess was so much more capable and demanding of love and intimacy than I was.
sentences.zh: 杰丝比我更有能力去爱和亲密，也对爱和亲密有更高的要求。

sentences.en: This was part of the attraction, but also the problem.
sentences.zh: 这是吸引力的一部分，但也是问题所在。

sentences.en: I was an ambivalent fortress, always defending against her siege while secretly hoping she would breach the walls.
sentences.zh: 我是一座矛盾的堡垒，一直在抵御她的围攻，同时又暗自希望她能攻破城墙。

sentences.en: In our third session,
sentences.zh: 在我们的第三次咨询中，

sentences.en: Reel said something that complicated the metaphor even more.
sentences.zh: 里尔说了一句话，让这个隐喻变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: Yes, he said, I am avoidant, but I'm also a love addict.
sentences.zh: 是的，他说，我是回避型的，但我也是一个爱情成瘾者。

sentences.en: I'm dependent on Jess for a steady drip of smiles, touches, attuned listening, and welcoming body language to affirm that I am being seen and valued.
sentences.zh: 我依赖杰丝源源不断地提供微笑、抚摸、专注的倾听和欢迎的肢体语言，来确认我被看到和被重视。

sentences.en: I need it to compensate for my low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 我需要它来弥补我低下的自尊心。

sentences.en: A fortress, maybe, but one that all along has been relying on the invaders at the gate for its essential supplies.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一座堡垒，但这座堡垒一直依赖着城门外的入侵者来提供它必不可少的补给。

sentences.en: The diagnosis comes after I relate the story of a tantrum I threw at my 48th birthday dinner.
sentences.zh: 这个诊断是在我讲述了我在48岁生日晚宴上大发脾气的故事之后做出的。

sentences.en: It involved me storming out of a restaurant in front of our kids and friends and coming back only after a solid 15-minute sulk.
sentences.zh: 当时我在我们的孩子和朋友面前怒气冲冲地离开餐馆，在结结实实地生了15分钟闷气后才回来。

sentences.en: It's not a flattering story, and I don't try to render it so.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个好听的故事，我也没有试图把它美化。

sentences.en: Jess and I argued beforehand about what restaurant to pick, which left us tense for days.
sentences.zh: 杰斯和我事先为选哪家餐厅争论不休，这让我们紧绷了好几天。

sentences.en: One of the kids was being difficult.
sentences.zh: 其中一个孩子当时很不听话。

sentences.en: Jess wasn't as affectionate as I wanted her to be.
sentences.zh: 杰斯不像我希望的那样对我表现出爱意。

sentences.en: I wasn't getting the birthday I felt I was owed.
sentences.zh: 我没有得到我自认为应得的生日。

sentences.en: I blew my stack.
sentences.zh: 我大发雷霆。

sentences.en: I finish the story and wait for Reel to give me a hard time about how I behaved.
sentences.zh: 我讲完这个故事，等着瑞尔对我的行为严厉批评。

sentences.en: He goes in a different direction.
sentences.zh: 他换了个方向。

sentences.en: How long have you been with this woman?
sentences.zh: 你和这个女人在一起多久了？

sentences.en: Reel asks.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔问。

sentences.en: We've been together 20 years, I say.
sentences.zh: 我说，我们在一起二十年了。

sentences.en: Been married for almost 18.
sentences.zh: 结婚快十八年了。

sentences.en: You're still in minute-to-minute doubt about whether she cares about you or not?
sentences.zh: 对于她是否在乎你，你到现在还每时每刻都在怀疑？

sentences.en: Yes, I say.
sentences.zh: 是的，我说。

sentences.en: So you know what I'm going to call that, right, Dan?
sentences.zh: 所以你知道我打算怎么称呼这个，对吧，丹？

sentences.en: I'm going to call that love addiction.
sentences.zh: 我打算把它叫做爱瘾。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: It's like using her warm regard as a self-esteem dialysis machine, Reel says.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔说，这就像是把她温暖的关注当成了自尊透析机。

sentences.en: When the warm regard is flowing, you feel pumped up and all's well with the world.
sentences.zh: 当温暖的关注源源不断时，你会感到充满活力，世界一切都好。

sentences.en: When it's not flowing, you get scared and lonely.
sentences.zh: 当它停止时，你会感到害怕和孤独。

sentences.en: I've been there.
sentences.zh: 我经历过。

sentences.en: I call it a self-esteem well-being crash.
sentences.zh: 我称之为自尊幸福感崩盘。

sentences.en: Empty, dark, jagged, cold, sharp, agitated.
sentences.zh: 空虚、黑暗、破碎、寒冷、尖锐、焦虑。

sentences.en: It's not until the fourth session that Reel really fillets me.
sentences.zh: 直到第四次咨询，瑞尔才真正把我剖析得体无完肤。

sentences.en: We've been talking about my anger and the ways it manifests.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论我的愤怒以及它的表现方式。

sentences.en: Sarcasm, yelling, quiet but venomous contempt.
sentences.zh: 讽刺、大吼大叫、表面平静却充满毒性的蔑视。

sentences.en: Reel has just told me, bluntly but compassionately, that I need to stop.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔刚刚直言不讳又充满同情地告诉我，我必须停下来。

sentences.en: I have two words for you, he says, and I say this with love.
sentences.zh: 他说，我有两句话要送给你，我是带着爱说这话的。

sentences.en: Wake up.
sentences.zh: 醒醒吧。

sentences.en: I need to learn how to deal with my distress in a way that doesn't involve dumping it all over my wife, and I need to do it now, not next month or next year.
sentences.zh: 我需要学会如何处理我的痛苦，而不是把它们全倾倒在我妻子身上，而且我必须现在就这么做，而不是下个月或明年。

sentences.en: This is nuts, he says to me, that you get to yell and scream at her and she is supposed to stay close to you?
sentences.zh: 他说，这太荒谬了，你可以对她大喊大叫，而她却还得对你死心塌地？

sentences.en: That's nuts, Dan.
sentences.zh: 丹，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: But it doesn't feel nuts because it's what you grew up with.
sentences.zh: 但它感觉并不荒谬，因为这是你从小到大习以为常的。

sentences.en: This lands.
sentences.zh: 这话戳中了要害。

sentences.en: I grew up in a family that didn't know how to deal straightforwardly with feelings.
sentences.zh: 我生长在一个不懂得如何直接处理情绪的家庭里。

sentences.en: We could talk about almost anything, as long as we could analyze it with limited emotional vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎可以谈论任何事情，只要我们能用有限的情感脆弱性去分析它。

sentences.en: Politics, ideas, sex, faith, family, people.
sentences.zh: 政治、思想、性、信仰、家庭、人际。

sentences.en: It was all fair game.
sentences.zh: 这些全都可以拿来讨论。

sentences.en: So much of the talk, however, was a way of smuggling feelings into ostensibly cerebral conversations.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多谈话只是一种将情感偷渡进表面上纯属理性探讨的对话中的方式。

sentences.en: When we were hurt, we yelled a lot.
sentences.zh: 当我们受伤时，我们会大喊大叫。

sentences.en: Often, we didn't talk at all.
sentences.zh: 通常，我们根本不说话。

sentences.en: For me, as a sensitive boy, it was devastatingly confusing, and I retreated into anger, withdrawal, and intellectualization.
sentences.zh: 作为一个敏感的男孩，这对我来说简直困惑到极点，我退缩进愤怒、疏离和理智化之中。

sentences.en: Anger was a defense against being sucked into someone else's chaos and also a means of seeking recognition.
sentences.zh: 愤怒既是对被卷入他人混乱的一种防御，也是一种寻求认可的手段。

sentences.en: Push them away, and if that doesn't work, then have a big raging fight.
sentences.zh: 把他们推开，如果这招不管用，那就大吵大闹一场。

sentences.en: At least, if we're yelling, my needs are being reckoned with.
sentences.zh: 至少，如果我们在大喊大叫，我的需求就得到了重视。

sentences.en: My solace was stories.
sentences.zh: 我的慰藉是故事。

sentences.en: TV shows, movies, science fiction, and fantasy novels.
sentences.zh: 电视节目、电影、科幻小说和奇幻小说。

sentences.en: I was safe and warm, tucked away in there with my action heroes, dogged detectives, and young wizards and warriors.
sentences.zh: 我感到安全而温暖，和我的动作英雄、顽强的侦探、年轻的巫师以及勇士们一起蜷缩在那个世界里。

sentences.en: And the whole family sought connection in intellectual exchange.
sentences.zh: 而整个家庭都在精神交流中寻求连结。

sentences.en: None of this translated very well to Jess.
sentences.zh: 这些在杰斯身上全盘皆输。

sentences.en: She crumples under the heat of anger and doesn't care much for TV or genre stories.
sentences.zh: 她在愤怒的高温下瑟瑟发抖，而且不太喜欢电视或类型故事。

sentences.en: Though she has her own defense mechanisms, born of her own trauma, they don't involve sublimating her emotions into cerebral claptrap.
sentences.zh: 尽管她有自己的防御机制，源自她自己的创伤，但它们并不涉及将自己的情绪转化为大脑理智的废话。

sentences.en: Real talks a lot in his book and in our sessions about the adaptive child, the part of us that evolves to survive in the hostile terrain of childhood.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔在他的书和我们的咨询中经常谈到“适应性儿童”，也就是我们为了在充满敌意的童年环境中生存而演变出的那部分自我。

sentences.en: It's what allows us to defer until later in life the distress that we don't have the resources to process when we're young.
sentences.zh: 正是这部分自我，让我们能够将年幼时没有资源去处理的痛苦推迟到以后的人生中去面对。

sentences.en: Now it's later, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，现在已经是以后了。

sentences.en: If our adaptive child is still running the algorithms for our adult relationships, we're in trouble.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的适应性儿童仍在为我们的成人关系运行着那些老旧的底层逻辑，我们就麻烦了。

sentences.en: In the footage, Real tells me to knock it off.
sentences.zh: 在录像里，瑞尔叫我别再这样了。

sentences.en: I remember hearing him, but only sort of.
sentences.zh: 我记得听到了他的话，但也只是模模糊糊地记得。

sentences.en: His observation cut so close to my core stance in the marriage, which is perhaps also my core fear.
sentences.zh: 他的观察精准切中了我在婚姻中的核心姿态，这或许也是我的核心恐惧。

sentences.en: If I don't scream for what I need, I will not be loved.
sentences.zh: 如果我不为我需要的东西大声尖叫，我就不会被爱。

sentences.en: I said none of this in the session.
sentences.zh: 我在咨询中什么也没说。

sentences.en: Instead, I protested articulately, but lamely, that I was making progress.
sentences.zh: 相反，我条理清晰但无力地辩解说我正在取得进展。

sentences.en: I'm better than I was a few years ago, I hear myself say in the recording, and I was better a few years ago than I was a few years before that.
sentences.zh: 我听到自己在录音里说，我比几年前好多了，而几年前我也比更早的时候好多了。

sentences.en: I'm not trying to excuse my bad behavior, but don't I get some credit for the trend line moving in the right direction?
sentences.zh: 我不是在为自己的不良行为找借口，但难道趋势线朝着正确的方向发展，我不该得到一些肯定吗？

sentences.en: Real isn't impressed.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔不为所动。

sentences.en: Your expectations of your own progress are pretty mediocre at best, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，你对自己进步的期望充其量只能算是一般般。

sentences.en: Just transpose it to the physical.
sentences.zh: 把它套用到身体暴力上。

sentences.en: Well, I only hit her twice this year.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我今年只打了她两次。

sentences.en: The year before that, I hit her 12 times.
sentences.zh: 前年，我打了她十二次。

sentences.en: Am I doing better?
sentences.zh: 我做得更好了吗？

sentences.en: No, not on my watch.
sentences.zh: 不，在我这里绝对没有。

sentences.en: How about cleaning it up altogether?
sentences.zh: 彻底改掉怎么样？

sentences.en: How about stopping it?
sentences.zh: 彻底停下来怎么样？

sentences.en: Hearing this from real is, at last, a ton of bricks.
sentences.zh: 从瑞尔口中听到这些，终于如同一记重锤落下。

sentences.en: The arsenal of rationalizations falls away.
sentences.zh: 种种合理化的借口烟消云散。

sentences.en: Yes, of course, this is right.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然，这是对的。

sentences.en: Enough.
sentences.zh: 够了。

sentences.en: Time to stop.
sentences.zh: 是时候停下来了。

sentences.en: How utterly embarrassing to think that it's okay to speak to my wife this way, to rage in front of my kids.
sentences.zh: 一想到自己竟然觉得用这种方式跟妻子说话、在孩子面前大发雷霆是可以接受的，就感到无比尴尬。

sentences.en: My blood pressure drops.
sentences.zh: 我的血压下降了。

sentences.en: I deflate into the couch.
sentences.zh: 我像泄了气一样瘫坐在沙发上。

sentences.en: The arrow that pierces is not reals comparing me to a wife beater, though that doesn't feel great.
sentences.zh: 刺痛我的并不是瑞尔把我比作虐妻狂——虽然这感觉并不好受。

sentences.en: It's this.
sentences.zh: 而是这个。

sentences.en: Your expectations of your own progress are pretty mediocre at beSt.
sentences.zh: 你对自己进步的期望充其量只能算是一般般。

sentences.en: This cuts not just to the core of the man I imagine myself to be, but also what I need to do to hold on to the life I share with Jess.
sentences.zh: 这句话不仅击中了我想象中那个自己的核心，也击中了我要维系与杰斯共同生活所必须做的事。

sentences.en: One of the tricky yet liberating things about Riel's practice is that, when it comes to rage, he doesn't care that much about matters of degree and scale.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔疗法中一个棘手却又让人释怀的地方在于，谈到暴怒时，他并不那么在乎程度和规模的大小。

sentences.en: Brutal physical abuse is violence, but so is rage, and so is lacerating contempt.
sentences.zh: 残酷的身体虐待是暴力，但暴怒是，尖刻的蔑视也是。

sentences.en: This is not abstract for Riel.
sentences.zh: 对瑞尔来说，这绝不是抽象的概念。

sentences.en: In I Don't Want to Talk About It, he tells the horrific story of his own family's generational cycle of abuse.
sentences.zh: 在《我不想谈论它》一书中，他讲了自己家族代代相传的虐待循环的可怕故事。

sentences.en: His grandfather tried to kill his father and uncle.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父曾试图杀死他的父亲和叔叔。

sentences.en: That was violence.
sentences.zh: 那是暴力。

sentences.en: His father, in turn, beat Riel.
sentences.zh: 而他的父亲，反过来又殴打瑞尔。

sentences.en: He whipped my brother and me if we dared to rebel, he writes.
sentences.zh: 他写道，如果我们胆敢反叛，他就会用皮鞭抽打我和哥哥。

sentences.en: And conversely, he whipped us if we showed too much vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果我们表现出太多的脆弱，他也会抽打我们。

sentences.en: Mostly, he whipped us as a proper man should to keep us corralled and teach us our lessons.
sentences.zh: 大体上，他抽打我们就像一个正派男人应该做的那样，好把我们管束好并给我们教训。

sentences.en: My modest rage, which isn't that bad, I find myself wanting to protest even now, is a violence that replaces intimacy with fear.
sentences.zh: 我现在发现自己想要辩解说，我那其实没那么严重的微小暴怒，其实也是一种用恐惧取代亲密的暴力。

sentences.en: What I encountered in my childhood is also violence.
sentences.zh: 我在童年时期遭遇的一切同样也是暴力。

sentences.en: In the gospel of Riel, we all deserve compassion for what was done to us.
sentences.zh: 在瑞尔的信条中，我们所有人都理应为曾经遭受的苦难获得同情。

sentences.en: He's not looking to shame us, but we're grown-ups now.
sentences.zh: 他不是为了羞辱我们，但我们已经是成年人了。

sentences.en: We should want better for ourselves and loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我们应该为自己和所爱之人追求更好的生活。

sentences.en: Watching the recording of Riel telling me to shape up, I noticed for the first time that Jess is crying.
sentences.zh: 看着瑞尔叫我振作起来的录像，我第一次注意到杰斯在哭。

sentences.en: She looks so sad.
sentences.zh: 她看起来那么难过。

sentences.en: Riel is confronting me, but also testifying to what my behavior has felt like to her.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔在与我对抗，但同时也是在证实我的行为对她而言是什么滋味。

sentences.en: How isolated and fearful it has left her.
sentences.zh: 这让她感到了怎样的孤立与恐惧。

sentences.en: And somehow, and this is the art of couples therapy at its most sophisticated, it's all one thing.
sentences.zh: 而不知为何——这也是最高水准的伴侣治疗的艺术所在——这一切都是一体的。

sentences.en: His confrontation of me, his affection for me, his validation of Jess, his care for her, his hope for our marriage.
sentences.zh: 他对我的对抗、他对我的爱意、他对杰斯的认可、他对她的关怀、他对我们婚姻的期许。

sentences.en: It's a sequence issue,
sentences.zh: 这是一个顺序问题，

sentences.en: Riel says a few minutes later.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后瑞尔说道。

sentences.en: For so long, through so many rounds of couples therapy, and so many fights between us, I have been demanding equity.
sentences.zh: 长久以来，经历了那么多轮伴侣治疗，以及我们之间的无数次争吵，我一直在要求对等。

sentences.en: I'll do this, but you need to do that.
sentences.zh: 我会这么做，但你需要那样做。

sentences.en: I'll calm down, but you need to stop withholding.
sentences.zh: 我会冷静下来，但你需要停止冷漠疏离。

sentences.en: I'll learn to hold your fears, but you need to learn to tolerate my anger.
sentences.zh: 我会学会承受你的恐惧，但你需要学会包容我的愤怒。

sentences.en: No,
sentences.zh: 不，

sentences.en: Riel says.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔说。

sentences.en: Anger blocks everything else, and has to leave the stage firSt.
sentences.zh: 愤怒会阻碍一切，必须最先离场。

sentences.en: I need to go firSt.
sentences.zh: 我必须先走这一步。

sentences.en: I get to go firSt.
sentences.zh: 我必须率先改变。

sentences.en: Epiphanies are real, but they're fragile.
sentences.zh: 顿悟是真实存在的，但它们却十分脆弱。

sentences.en: They are a one-leafed seedling, pushing up through the crust of the ground, or a blind hatchling, waiting naked and alone for its mother to return with a worm.
sentences.zh: 它们就像破土而出的一片单叶幼苗，又或是赤裸孤单地等待母亲带虫子回来的雏鸟。

sentences.en: They are easily crushed underfoot or done in by harsh weather.
sentences.zh: 它们很容易被双脚踩碎，或被恶劣的天气摧毁。

sentences.en: If they're not protected and nurtured, they will crumble and blow away in the wind as though they never existed.
sentences.zh: 如果不加保护和培育，它们就会枯萎并在风中消散，就像从未存在过一样。

sentences.en: Session four was an epiphany for me, but one that would need to survive the crucible of conflict, not once, but repeatedly to establish its reality.
sentences.zh: 第四次咨询对我是个顿悟，但这个顿悟必须经受冲突的严峻考验，不是一次，而是反复经历，才能确立其真实性。

sentences.en: A few hours after the session ended, driving back from dinner,
sentences.zh: 咨询结束几个小时后，在开车回家的路上，

sentences.en: Jess and I got into a tiff.
sentences.zh: 杰斯和我起了一点争执。

sentences.en: She said something that upset me, and I started to snap, but then I stopped.
sentences.zh: 她说了一些让我心烦的话，我正要发作，但随后我停了下来。

sentences.en: I need to get out of the car, I said to her, as calmly as I could.
sentences.zh: 我需要下车，我尽量平静地对她说。

sentences.en: We were only about a half mile from our house, so I walked the rest of the way, stopping at the market mid-route for a few things.
sentences.zh: 我们离家只有半英里左右，所以我一路步行回家，中途在集市上停下来买了几样东西。

sentences.en: By the time I got home,
sentences.zh: 等我回到家时，

sentences.en: Jess and I had both cooled off, and we were able to stay connected the remainder of the night.
sentences.zh: 杰斯和我都已经冷静了下来，我们在接下来的整晚都保持着情感上的连结。

sentences.en: It was a small but important victory.
sentences.zh: 这是一场虽小但意义重大的胜利。

sentences.en: Real has a bit he does when clients say they can't control themselves in a moment of distress.
sentences.zh: 当客户说他们在痛苦时刻无法控制自己时，瑞尔有一套标准说辞。

sentences.en: No one selectively loses control, he says to me.
sentences.zh: 他对我说，没有人会有选择性地失控。

sentences.en: Would I rage, he asks, if he had a gun to my daughter's head?
sentences.zh: 他问，如果有人用枪指着我女儿的头，我还会暴怒吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: Then it's not can't, it's won't.
sentences.zh: 那这就不是“不能”，而是“不愿”。

sentences.en: It's a choice.
sentences.zh: 这是一种选择。

sentences.en: Every small victory over can't is evidence that I'm not impotent before the whims of my adaptive child, even when I've already traveled a step down the road toward meltdown.
sentences.zh: 每一次对“不能”的小小胜利都证明了，即便我已经踏上了走向情绪崩盘的道路，我在适应性儿童的任性面前也并非无能为力。

sentences.en: I was starting to believe.
sentences.zh: 我开始相信了。

sentences.en: Much of the next two sessions is the scut work of gaming out what it would look like for the two of us to deal better with our inevitable failures
sentences.zh: 接下来两次咨询的大部分内容，都是些繁琐的工作，也就是推演我们俩该如何更好地处理不可避免的失败，

sentences.en: to be the most evolved versions of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 从而成为各自进化得最完美的版本。

sentences.en: We talk about timeouts and reals very specific instructions for how to take one.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了暂停机制以及瑞尔关于如何进行暂停的具体指示。

sentences.en: We talk about the feedback wheel, which is a series of structured steps he recommends for constructively bringing a complaint to your partner.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了反馈轮，这是他推荐的一系列结构化步骤，用于向伴侣建设性地提出抱怨。

sentences.en: We run through a few typically fraught scenarios, scripting out how we might talk to each other better than we have in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们演练了几个通常令人紧绷的情景，编写了我们如何能比过去更好地彼此对话的剧本。

sentences.en: These aren't new ideas or practices for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这些并不是什么新概念或新做法。

sentences.en: We've read his books.
sentences.zh: 我们读过他的书。

sentences.en: We've both been to a lot of therapy before.
sentences.zh: 我们俩以前都做过很多心理治疗。

sentences.en: As a couples therapist,
sentences.zh: 作为一名伴侣治疗师，

sentences.en: Jess has been guiding people in this kind of work for years.
sentences.zh: 杰斯多年来一直在指导人们从事这种工作。

sentences.en: The truth remains, though, that when the task is one of deep brain rewiring, no one is exempt.
sentences.zh: 然而事实依然是，当任务是进行深度大脑重塑时，没有人能例外。

sentences.en: Not real, not Jess.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔不能，杰斯不能。

sentences.en: Definitely not me.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不能。

sentences.en: Two steps forward, one and nine-tenths of a step back.
sentences.zh: 前进两步，又退了一点九步。

sentences.en: How are you feeling about your husband these days?
sentences.zh: 这些天你对你丈夫有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Reel asks in session six.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔在第六次咨询时问道。

sentences.en: I mean, mostly good, Jess says.
sentences.zh: 杰丝说，我的意思是，大部分都挺好的。

sentences.en: She is cautious.
sentences.zh: 她很谨慎。

sentences.en: I can see it on the video.
sentences.zh: 我在视频里能看出来。

sentences.en: I knew it then.
sentences.zh: 我当时就知道了。

sentences.en: She hasn't had an epiphany.
sentences.zh: 她并没有什么顿悟。

sentences.en: I'm not sure she needed one, but she did need to see a way forward for us.
sentences.zh: 我不确定她是否需要顿悟，但她确实需要为我们看到一条前进的路。

sentences.en: The hope is visible in treatment and in the days between.
sentences.zh: 希望在治疗中以及平时的日子里都能看到。

sentences.en: I can feel her opening up to me.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到她对我敞开心扉。

sentences.en: It's tentative, but real.
sentences.zh: 虽然还有些试探，但却是真实的。

sentences.en: She has her tasks, too, and is willing to undertake them if I can make it safe for her.
sentences.zh: 她也有自己的任务，如果我能让她感到安全，她也愿意去完成这些任务。

sentences.en: You're very cute, and I'm sort of jealous of you and how unprotected you are, I say, my eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 我闭上眼睛说，你真可爱，我有点嫉妒你，嫉妒你这么毫无防备。

sentences.en: I can't imagine being that open to being hurt, but I want to be that open to being loved.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象自己能那样毫无防备地去承受伤害，但我渴望能那样毫无防备地去爱。

sentences.en: It's the last of our eight sessions, and I'm talking to my inner child.
sentences.zh: 这是我们八次咨询的最后一次，我正在跟我的内在小孩对话。

sentences.en: I remember, under Reel's guidance, closing my eyes and bringing him up out of my memory so that we could talk.
sentences.zh: 在瑞尔的引导下，我记起自己闭上眼睛，把他从记忆中唤出来，这样我们就能对话了。

sentences.en: He was six or seven, a bit chubby, wearing clunky eyeglasses and shorts pulled up too high above his waiSt.
sentences.zh: 他当时六七岁，有点胖，戴着笨重的眼镜，短裤拉得高高地卡在腰部以上。

sentences.en: He's a composite, I realize now, of details of me at my most awkward self across the ages.
sentences.zh: 我现在意识到，他是各个年龄段中我最笨拙时期的种种细节组合而成的。

sentences.en: I find this session the hardest of all of them to watch.
sentences.zh: 我发现这次咨询是所有咨询中最难回看的一次。

sentences.en: What we talk about is intensely vulnerable, but that's not the most difficult part, nor is it imagining the silent audience evaluating me.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的内容极其脆弱，但这并不是最困难的部分，想象着沉默的观众在评判我也不是。

sentences.en: It's that I'm too sealed off from it, then and now.
sentences.zh: 最难的是，无论是过去还是现在，我都把自己跟它隔绝得太紧了。

sentences.en: I couldn't, can't, feel it in the way I so urgently want to.
sentences.zh: 我过去不能，现在也不能，用我那么渴望的方式去感受它。

sentences.en: When therapy is dramatized on TV or in the movies, there's a classic scene where the deep childhood trauma is finally exposed.
sentences.zh: 当心理治疗在电视或电影中被戏剧化时，通常都有一个经典场景，那就是深层的童年创伤终于被揭开。

sentences.en: It's not your fault,
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错，

sentences.en: Robin Williams says to Matt Damon in Good Will Hunting, referring to the gruesome abuse
sentences.zh: 罗宾·威廉姆斯在《心灵捕手》中对马特·达蒙说，指的是

sentences.en: Damon's character suffered in foster care.
sentences.zh: 达蒙饰演的角色在寄养家庭中遭受的可怕虐待。

sentences.en: Damon tries to turn away from him to deflect his approach.
sentences.zh: 达蒙试图转身避开他，化解他的靠近。

sentences.en: Williams keeps moving forward.
sentences.zh: 威廉姆斯继续步步紧逼。

sentences.en: It's not your fault.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错。

sentences.en: It's not your fault.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错。

sentences.en: Eventually, Damon breaks down in tears they embrace.
sentences.zh: 最终，达蒙崩溃大哭，两人拥抱在一起。

sentences.en: It's a turning point in the therapy, in the character's life.
sentences.zh: 这是治疗过程中的一个转折点，也是这个角色人生的转折点。

sentences.en: I want my tears.
sentences.zh: 我想要我的眼泪。

sentences.en: I want my catharsis.
sentences.zh: 我想要我的宣泄。

sentences.en: I want my scene.
sentences.zh: 我想要我的场景。

sentences.en: I'm also afraid of what it means that I can't achieve them.
sentences.zh: 我也害怕自己无法达成这一切意味着什么。

sentences.en: Real asks me to describe what I'm feeling in my body as we talk to my inner child.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔让我描述一下，当我们跟我的内在小孩对话时，我的身体有什么感觉。

sentences.en: It's like I'm inflating from the inside right now, I say.
sentences.zh: 我说，就好像我此刻正在从内部膨胀起来。

sentences.en: What's your body filling with?
sentences.zh: 你的身体里在充进什么？

sentences.en: He asks.
sentences.zh: 他问。

sentences.en: Energy, I tell him.
sentences.zh: 能量，我告诉他。

sentences.en: Trapped energy.
sentences.zh: 被困住的能量。

sentences.en: He asks again what it feels like.
sentences.zh: 他又问这是一种什么感觉。

sentences.en: I pause.
sentences.zh: 我停顿了一下。

sentences.en: What finally comes to mind are the tantrums I would have sometimes when I was young.
sentences.zh: 最终浮现我脑海的是我小时候有时会发脾气的情形。

sentences.en: My temper tantrums, as my mom called them.
sentences.zh: 也就是我妈妈所说的那种发脾气。

sentences.en: An explosion of anger.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的爆发。

sentences.en: Screaming, hitting the floor.
sentences.zh: 尖叫，捶地板。

sentences.en: Smashing against the universe.
sentences.zh: 向整个世界发起猛烈撞击。

sentences.en: There was this sense that there was this massive rage inside of me, I say, that would just come out in these sort of violent ways.
sentences.zh: 我说，当时有一种感觉，我的内心有一股巨大的狂怒，只会以这种暴烈的方式宣泄出来。

sentences.en: And I guess that I was scary to other people.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时对别人来说是吓人的。

sentences.en: Real keeps me in that space, eyes closed, talking to my inner child for about 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔让我保持那种状态，闭上眼睛，跟我的内在小孩对话大约 30 分钟。

sentences.en: We ask him what he was mad about, what he was trying to feel or say that could only express itself through inchoate rage.
sentences.zh: 我们问他到底在生什么气，他试图去感受或表达什么，而这些只能通过无法言说的狂怒来宣泄。

sentences.en: I get angry on his behalf that he didn't feel safe enough to be all of himself.
sentences.zh: 我替他感到生气，因为他觉得不够安全，无法展现完整的自己。

sentences.en: I take him in my arms and embrace him.
sentences.zh: 我把他揽入怀中，拥抱他。

sentences.en: I promise to hear him and protect him from now on.
sentences.zh: 我答应他，从今以后我会倾听他、保护他。

sentences.en: It's not as hard as I feared it would be to inhabit this role, even though it has its corny aspects.
sentences.zh: 扮演这个角色并没有我想象的那么难，尽管它确实有些老套。

sentences.en: I don't break, though, or break through.
sentences.zh: 不过，我没有崩溃，也没有实现突破。

sentences.en: The energy remains trapped by my skin.
sentences.zh: 能量依然被困在我的皮肤里。

sentences.en: The box of tissues next to me, which Real asked Jess to get before we started the exercise, remains unused.
sentences.zh: 我身边的纸巾盒——这是瑞尔在开始练习前让杰丝拿来的——依然原封不动。

sentences.en: I'm not surprised, but I am disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我并不感到意外，但我确实很失望。

sentences.en: Jess looks enigmatic on the recording.
sentences.zh: 录像里的杰丝看起来高深莫测。

sentences.en: I can't read her.
sentences.zh: 我读不懂她。

sentences.en: At the end, I put my inner child back inside myself and open my eyes.
sentences.zh: 最后，我把内在小孩收回自己体内，然后睁开眼睛。

sentences.en: Real tells me I did a good job.
sentences.zh: 瑞尔告诉我，我做得很好。

sentences.en: Joy, pain, anger, fear, shame, guilt, love.
sentences.zh: 快乐、痛苦、愤怒、恐惧、羞耻、内疚、爱。

sentences.en: What are you feeling right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在有什么感觉？

sentences.en: He asks.
sentences.zh: 他问。

sentences.en: I guess I feel loved, I say.
sentences.zh: 我想我感到了爱，我说。

sentences.en: So what you're feeling right now, he says, is the cure for love addiction, Dan.
sentences.zh: 他说，丹，所以你现在感受到的，就是治疗爱瘾的良方。

sentences.en: I remember believing him.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时自己相信了他的话。

sentences.en: I still do.
sentences.zh: 我现在依然相信。

sentences.en: Instead of looking to Jess to top me off with love, I need to take on that responsibility myself.
sentences.zh: 我不需要指望杰丝用爱来为我充电，我要自己承担起这个责任。

sentences.en: I have to be my own keeper so that I can be whole for the people I love the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我必须做自己的守护者，这样才能为了我最爱的人们保持完整。

sentences.en: What worries me watching this now is simply that I don't know if I'll be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 现在回看这段录像，我担心的事情很简单，那就是我不知道自己能否做到这一点。

sentences.en: It's an odd endeavor trying to evolve into a version of yourself that you can only perceive from your present self somewhat dimly.
sentences.zh: 试图进化成一个你只能从现在的自己身上隐约感知到的未来版本的自己，这是一项奇怪的努力。

sentences.en: Am I waiting for the tears to come in a crystalline moment of cathartic release?
sentences.zh: 我是不是在等待眼泪在某个充满宣泄释放的晶莹剔透的时刻夺眶而出？

sentences.en: Is it enough to follow the program day by day, time out by time out, evolving by increments?
sentences.zh: 日复一日地遵循计划，一次次地暂停，一点点地进化，这就够了吗？

sentences.en: I'm not yet whole, and the way forward isn't entirely clear.
sentences.zh: 我还没有变得完整，前行的路也并非完全清晰。

sentences.en: But something has shifted in our marriage.
sentences.zh: 但我们的婚姻确实发生了某种转变。

sentences.en: There has been an expansion in the space for connection.
sentences.zh: 建立联结的空间变大了。

sentences.en: We're talking more.
sentences.zh: 我们交流得更多了。

sentences.en: We're tolerating more.
sentences.zh: 我们的容忍度更高了。

sentences.en: We're better at repair.
sentences.zh: 我们更擅长修复关系了。

sentences.en: My protection is no longer a coat of armor, hard shell and opaque.
sentences.zh: 我的保护不再是一副厚重的铠甲、坚硬的外壳且不透光。

sentences.en: It's more of a translucent force field.
sentences.zh: 它更像是一个半透明的力场。

sentences.en: It surrounds me, filtering the light, protecting and denying me, but also, in the right conditions, letting some rays pass through.
sentences.zh: 它环绕着我，过滤着光线，既保护我又拒绝我，但在合适的环境下，它也会让一些光线穿透进来。

sentences.en: The rest is waiting for me, whatever it is, on the other side.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就是等待我了，无论那是什么，都在另一边等待着。

sentences.en: Waiting for Jess, too.
sentences.zh: 也在等待着杰丝。

sentences.en: More often than not these days, I can feel her hand reaching through into mine.
sentences.zh: 这些天，十有八九我都能感觉到她的手伸过来握住了我的手。

sentences.en: This week on
sentences.zh: 本周的

sentences.en: The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 《割草机秀》中，我们要为假期招待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 请收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean, do they black out to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕过去才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在你喜欢的任何地方收听《割草机秀》。
